text: This solution, State highway and local roads recovery funding (Budget 2024) addresses natural catastrophe in New Zealand between New Zealand Government, NZ Transport Agency Waka Kotahi, Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (DPMC), Affected local councils, Regional Transport Organizations, and Local Government New Zealand (LGNZ). The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
